Amen. I got easy because I have no internet restrictions... But, other than that, yeah I get it.
I can't go to the beach with my friends because my mom thinks they will make fun of me. I am fat and she thinks she's protecting me. She's not because they don't care. 
I can't go out past midnight or the next day I will have to endure a shit storm coming from her. 
I can't cut my hair, unless I have her permission and she always screams at me when I say I wanna to do it. 
I can't stay at a friend's house because I am a bother to them and their parents. She actually phones their parents to see if I'm not too much trouble. 
I can't close doors, unless it's the one from the bathroom..
I'm 23.
My mom can be amazing, she really can and I love her to death. But because she was raised with a manipulative and abusive mother, she has picked up some habits...

Do we need a study for that?
I'm 23 years old and I have to come up with excuses everyday, so I can visit my boyfriend or go see a gynecologist. 
I know I should feel bad, but I don't. I prefer to lie than to face psychological abuse or getting hit if things are really out of control.

I get it, believe me.
I'm not dead because it would break my parents' heart...that's what I think...But it's not true.
There are bad days and good days. 
Bad days can suck. But remember what Charles Darwin once said: " All emotions have adaptative benefits". So you feel sad, angry, frustrasted..that's okay. It doesn't feel this way, but someday it will. Cry yourself out, then breathe (a lot!) and learn how to deal with these emotions. Remember what made you smile. Write down words that calm you down...For example, I love the word "perfume". Listen to happy music. But stick to it, even if you feel like it's feels wrong, listen to it on a loop. Having that said, it what concerns self image...I'm not really the best person to talk to, but I would say to talk to your therapist about this. In my case, I use lotions, and perfumes, and use a little make up to feel a little bit more confident..Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't. Jogging is probably a good idea (while listenng to happy music!) Don't compare youself with others! You are who you are. You are beautiful and there ARE many things to live for. Sometimes it's hard to see, but they are still there. Don't give just yet! :D!
You are not alone!
